probe: P1 phrase/NEAR reachability with matched hit control
bed_access: sqlite3 file:...?mode=ro (read-only URI); no writes, no index creation, no VACUUM
kill_criterion: KILL if (a) exact-phrase probes return a gold chunk for well under half of the 37 basic pool-absent misses, OR (b) the phrase-fire rate on MISSES is not materially higher than on a matched sample of HITS -- a lane that fires equally on both cannot discriminate and cannot move delivered_gold_rate. Operationalised before running: (a) fires if the reach rate on the 37 basic pool-absent misses < 0.40 ('well under half'); 0.40-0.50 reads as 'about half' and does not by itself fire (a). (b) fires if miss_reach_rate - matched_hit_reach_rate < 0.10 absolute ('not materially higher'). Verdict is KILL if either limb fires, PASS only if neither fires, INCONCLUSIVE if the inputs cannot support the measurement.
verdict_reason: limb (a) reach on the 37 basic pool-absent misses = 31/37 = 0.8378 (threshold 0.40 -> does not fire); limb (b) miss reach 0.7372 minus matched-hit reach 0.9316 = -0.1944 (needs >= 0.10 -> FIRES).

method.tokenisation: query.lower(), split on regex [^0-9a-z]+, drop empty tokens; order preserved, nothing reordered
method.reading_b_primary: contiguous n-grams over the ORIGINAL token stream (stopwords retained in place), keeping only n-grams containing >=1 non-stopword term. Every emitted phrase is one that really occurs in the query text.
method.reading_a_secondary: stopwords deleted first, then contiguous n-grams over the reduced sequence. Reported as a sensitivity arm only: it fabricates phrases that occur in no document and therefore biases reachability DOWN.
method.df_definition: count(*) FROM genes_fts WHERE genes_fts MATCH '{content complement}: "<phrase>"'. The fts 'content' column is source_id + promoter tags + gene content (see view genes_fts_source), so DF is document frequency over that concatenation; 'complement' is included so the probe is generous to the lane.
method.df_cap_meaning: phrases with DF > 5000 are recorded but not treated as a usable lane; 'reach_any_df' reports reachability with the cap lifted.
method.reachability: EXACT, not sampled: for every candidate phrase with DF>=1, each gold rowid is tested with 'MATCH ? AND rowid = ?'. Phrases are walked in ascending DF, so reach_df is the LOWEST-DF phrase that lands on gold. No top-k truncation is applied, so reach_rate is the lane's CEILING, not a forecast.
method.topfew_variant: reach_topfew restricts the lane to the 3 most selective eligible phrases -- closer to what a real lane would issue.
method.near: NEAR("t1" "t2", 10) over the two lowest-DF non-stopword query terms with DF>=1; same exact rowid reachability test.
method.error_handling: every FTS5 call is wrapped in try/except; malformed expressions are logged to fts_errors and skipped, never fatal

hit_control.stratification: question_type, matched cell-for-cell to the miss type mix; names sorted then seeded-shuffled per stratum

section_1_selectivity.note: Tests the premise that a phrase is ~90x more selective than the best single term. selectivity_ratio = min_content_term_df / min_nonzero_phrase_df, computed PER QUERY; distribution reported, not a mean alone.

section_5_reading_a_sensitivity.note: stopword-deleted n-grams; expected to under-report reachability because some emitted phrases occur in no document

section_6_standardised_control.why: the cell-for-cell mix-matched sample could only reach n=117 (<156): the miss population is 82/156 semantic but only 43 of 314 hits are semantic, so semantic is the binding stratum. Two composition-proof replacements.

direct_standardisation.definition: per-question_type reach rate measured on ALL 314 hits, reweighted by the miss type mix (sum_t w_t * rate_t / sum_t w_t)

section_7_topk_selectivity_curve.why: the main run measured the lane only at k=3 (reach_topfew) and k=all-eligible (reach_rate). This is the curve in between: does ANY practical top-k phrase-selection rule surface gold? k is a rank over phrases sorted by ascending DF -- exactly the selectivity rule the lever proposes.

verdict_reason_addendum: Limb (b) re-graded on the composition-proof bases now that the mix-matched sample was capped at n=117: direct standardisation of ALL 314 hits to the miss type mix gives hit reach 0.9126 vs miss reach 0.7372, delta -0.1754 (needs >= 0.10); and the within-stratum comparison finds 0 of 7 question_type strata where misses fire materially more than hits. Limb (b) FIRES on every basis. The top-k curve adds that at the k a real lane would use the miss reach is 0.0321 (k=3) / 0.1603 (k=10) / 0.6282 (k=50), each BELOW the hit rate at the same k. Verdict unchanged: KILL.
